answer: Each identity posts a 4,000 POA slashable bond for 18 epochs, and rewards vest only after 6 unique established peers attest that the same key wrote original answers in at least 4 of those epochs. A farm of 80 aliases would lock 320,000 POA with no vest until every key independently earned those seals; one proven duplicate slashes 25% of that bond. The first cheap ripple of clones therefore dies against the meadow of required peer seals, and only a clean unshared key reaches the dune of vested payouts.
